description: Use the [GLM-ASR-2512](/guides/audio/glm-asr-2512) model to transcribe audio files into text, supporting multiple languages and real-time streaming transcription.

file.description: The audio file to be transcribed. Supported audio file formats: `.wav / .mp3`. Specifications: file size ≤ `25 MB`, audio duration ≤ `30 seconds`.

file_base64.description: Base64 encoded audio file. Only one of file_base64 or file needs to be provided (if both are provided, file takes precedence).

hotwords.description: Hotword list to improve recognition accuracy for domain-specific vocabulary. Format example: ["person_name","place_name"]. Recommended not to exceed 100 items.

prompt.description: In long text scenarios, you can provide previous transcription results as context. Recommended to be less than 8000 characters.

request_id.description: Passed by the user side, needs to be unique; used to distinguish each request, 6–64 characters. If not provided by the user side, the platform will generate one by default.

stream.description: This parameter should be set to `false` or omitted when using synchronous calls. It indicates that the model returns all content at once after generating all content. Default is `false`. If set to `true`, the model will return generated content in chunks via standard `Event Stream`. When the `Event Stream` ends, a `data: [DONE]` message will be returned.

user_id.description: Unique ID for the end user, 6–128 characters. Avoid using sensitive information.

created.description: Request creation time, as a `Unix` timestamp in seconds.

request_id.description: Passed by the client, must be unique. A unique identifier to distinguish each request. If not provided by the client, the platform will generate one by default.

text.description: The complete transcribed content of the audio.

created.description: Request creation time, as a `Unix` timestamp in seconds.

delta.description: Incremental audio transcription information returned by the model.

type.description: Audio transcription event type. `transcript.text.delta` indicates transcription in progress, `transcript.text.done` indicates transcription completed.
